nodes.name: Note: how to read this workflow

parameters.content:
## HARSLL – Dispatcher: from spreadsheet to finished batch
Starts when a spreadsheet arrives, every 15 minutes, or on Run now. Reads left to right, then top to bottom. Three jobs are done by other workflows:

- **HARSLL – Dispatcher: take in a file**, once per spreadsheet
- **HARSLL – Performer**, once per case (it uses **HARSLL – Performer: RBIS adapter** for RBIS)
- **HARSLL – Dispatcher: report a batch**, once per spreadsheet waiting for its summary

Their IDs come from **HARSLL – Settings**.

## 1. Start
Settings, the lock, and the list of spreadsheets that have stopped changing.

## 2. Take in each file
One call per file to **HARSLL – Dispatcher: take in a file**.

## 3a. Close stuck cases
Cases with no tries left are closed as failed.

## 3b. Run the Performer on each case
Oldest first. A case waits if an earlier case on the same account is unfinished. The lock is refreshed after every case.

## 3c. Report each finished batch
One call per batch to **HARSLL – Dispatcher: report a batch**.
